'''''Sparaxis grandiflora''''', the '''plain harlequin flower''', is a species of flowering plant in the genus ''[[Sparaxis]]'', family [[Iridaceae]], found in the [[Western Cape]] province of [[South Africa]].<ref name="Tropicos">{{cite web |title=Sparaxis grandiflora |website=Tropicos |url=http://legacy.tropicos.org/Name/16601389 |access-date=26 March 2021 }}</ref> It has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref>{{cite web |title=''Sparaxis grandiflora'' plain harlequin flower |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/22441/Sparaxis-grandiflora/Details |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |access-date=29 March 2021 }}</ref>
